title: Mechanical Skull Over Sea
description: A large bronze mechanical skull with exposed gears and blue glowing eye dominates the foreground, its mouth pouring a vibrant blue liquid waterfall containing numerous painted eyes that flows into a stormy sea. A small wooden sailing ship navigates the turbulent blue waters below while distant rocky islands with lighthouses stand under a dark, aurora-filled sky.
prompt: A massive bronze steampunk skeleton skull with intricate gears, blue glowing eye, and TikTok logo on its forehead, positioned at the edge of a cliff overlooking a stormy ocean. Blue liquid pours from its open mouth like a waterfall, carrying dozens of painted eyeballs that flow down toward a small wooden sailing ship. Dark rocky islands with multiple lighthouses in the background under a dramatic night sky with green and purple aurora borealis, dark moody atmosphere, surreal painting style with visible brushstrokes
